svg.title: Model timing residuals under separate GCC mean and GCC 90 operators
svg.desc: Box plots show residual distributions for 37 frozen ensemble members at twelve source transitions per product. The green band marks plus or minus 21 days. Text above incomplete cells reports available crossings out of 37.
